name: temporal_guard_v1_04s
description: Leakage guard for RQ2 (pre-specified after seeing temporal_v1, before running this): every temporal feature (time-on-ball and movement history) is computed 0.4 s BEFORE the release frame, so no frame near the kick can enter it. Static decision-time spatial features are unchanged. If the H-T2 gain is kick leakage it should vanish here.
